newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aames Financial raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aames Financial raised.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffrey, on Thursday, raised its rating on Aames Financial Corp to a strong buy from its prior rating of buy.
-- Analysts Jeffrey Evanson and Steven Schroll said they kept their 1997 earnings per share estimates at $3.05 and raised 1998 estimates to $3.90 from $3.80.
-- Kept 12-month price target at $54 a share.
-- shares rose 3-1/8 to 44-5/8 in midafternoon exchange trading.
-- The analysts cited solid first quarter earnings results, the good strategic fit of the One Stop Mortgage Inc.

-- The analysts also said that given that competition has begun driving industry-wide profitability down, they were impressed with Aames' ability to generate high loan volume growth in the first quarter.
